kashika: माङ्युपपदे धातोर्लुङ् प्रत्ययो भवति। सर्वलकाराणामपवादः। मा कार्षीत्। मा हार्षीत्। कथं मा भवतु तस्य पापम्, मा भविष्यतीति? असाधुरेवायम्। केचिदाहुः — अङिदपरो माशब्दो विद्यते, तस्यायं प्रयोगः॥
kashikaEnglish: लुङ् (aorist) with माङ् (prohibition): मा कार्षीत् 'let him not do!', मा हार्षीत् 'let him not take!' Augment elided by 6.4.74.
englishShort: In presence of the अव्यय माङ्, लुङ्लकारः is used.
englishFull:
माङि लुङ् — The Aorist (लुङ्) applies after a verb when माङ् is in composition.

This sets aside all other tense-affixes.

| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| मा कार्षीत् | let him not do |
| मा हार्षीत् | let him not take |

@note[The Imperative and Future in मा भवतु तस्य पापम्, मा भविष्यति are against good usage. Alternatively, there is another मा without indicatory ङ्, with which other tenses apply.]
